metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean pairwise cosine of sampled nonpadding item embeddings mapped to [0,1]. Higher indicates greater average directional alignment; 0.5 corresponds to zero mean cosine. This statistic alone does not establish embedding collapse or recommendation diversity. Null when fewer than two embeddings are available.
metric_definitions.embedding_sample_count: Number of sampled nonpadding embeddings with finite coordinates and strictly positive FP32 norm used for cosine; cosine is null with fewer than two valid embeddings.
metric_definitions.embedding_excluded_count: Number of sampled embeddings excluded because coordinates are nonfinite or FP32 norm is zero. Exclusions require investigation and are not evidence of healthy embeddings.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative training logit over finite, nonpadding positions; null without samples. Pairwise separation does not establish sampled HR@10 or full-catalog ranking.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Training-position counts for margin<eps and margin<0, with valid_positions reporting finite nonpadding sample support. Category lists remain empty because item categories are unavailable in this task.
